primary_assumption: Image blocks approximately independent within source ranges; not established for physical fruits/batches.
normality_and_equal_variance: Not required for the chosen nonparametric paired image-bootstrap; no t-test/ANOVA performed.
missing_data: No image/GT drop, all2000 AP draws contain four target classes; attribute/continuous-score test targets unavailable and omitted.
zero_difference: Degenerate zero paired escape difference is an observed invariance, not equivalence or absence of population risk.

rows.assessment: All four source groups have higher correct/all-GT for primary than raw. Per-group AP is not averaged; smallest group lacks UQ, so no universal subgroup-AP claim.
Bootstrap unit is image; source ranges are not proven physical-fruit or harvest-batch independence.
Existing curated dataset, mixed rule/review labels; no claim of population-representative fruit quality.
Conditional grading selects localized instances; correct/all-GT and localization are also reported, not only the selected subset.
UQ prevalence reported as 25/576; escape 2/25 and qualified rejection denominators retained.
Paired fixed algorithms on the same frozen images, not a selected extreme-score pre/post intervention.
All129 images and576GT retained;16 unlocalized GT counted separately. Conditional560 denominator is explicit.
Five frozen arms and six contrasts reported, including RR22-minus-NMS CI crossing zero. Pointwise intervals unadjusted; no stars/p-values.
Development adaptation and early baseline test use retained; methods and primary endpoint frozen before current test. Bootstrap details recorded after point estimates.
Controlled algorithm comparison supports performance differences on this partition, not causal nutrition/commercial sorting outcomes.
Prediction precedes GT evaluation; no observational causal direction between fruit attributes and commercial outcomes is asserted.
